You're here. I didn't expect you so soon...
strings.예전에 다녀오셨던 '표류도시'를 기억하시나요?: Do you remember the Drifting City you visited?
strings.(아직 기억하고 있다. 미래를 해피엔딩으로 만들겠다는 약속은 아직 진행: (I still remember. My promise to give the future a happy ending is still a work in progress...)
strings.아, 죄송해요. 제가 잠깐 다른 생각 하느라…. 표류도시에 무슨 일이라도: Oh, sorry. My mind wandered... Has something happened in the Drifting City?
strings.암브로시아가 모험가님을 찾더군요. 정확히 무슨 일인지는 잘 모르겠지만,: Ambrosia is looking for you. I don't know the details, but I think it's about her sister.
Yes, you know her. Visit Ambrosia when you have time.
strings.어디 있는 지는 아시겠죠?: You know where to find her?
It is her hobby. I hope it's nothing serious.
strings.야호! 잘 왔어! 안 그래도 소식 들었어, 여신의 망나니라고!: Yahoo! Welcome! I've heard the news, Goddess's Executioner!
strings.좌절하지 마. 지금 그게 중요한 게 아니니까!: Don't despair. That's not important now!
Right. Jade said you were looking for me.
The Mongle Mongle Guild is formally commissioning the adventurer %s.
strings.연합의 의뢰를 완료하면 나중에 많은 도움을 받을 수 있어. 안 그래도 여: Complete Alliance requests, and you'll receive plenty of help later. The Goddess's Executioner probably has quite a high rank already, without knowing it.
I get it. But please stop saying Goddess's Executioner...
strings.날 믿는 만큼 확실한 일을 줄게. 오직 %s만 할 수 있는 일이니까!: Trust me, and I'll give you a proper job. Something only you can do, %s!
strings.(뭔가 속는 기분이지만, 적당히 장단을 맞춰줄까?): (I feel like I'm being tricked, but should I play along?)
strings.내 동생 알지? 아니스가 휴가를 받아 오기로 했는데, 표류도시에 일이 생: You know my sister? Anise was supposed to visit on leave, but something happened in the Drifting City.
Her big sister waited so long. Hmph.
strings.에이, 이게 아니고. 마음 같아선 그곳에 가서 직접 얼굴 보고 싶은데,: Anyway, I want to go see her myself, but as guild master, I can't leave.
strings.특별한 사람이 아니면 오랫동안 머무는 것도 힘들어서 그래. 여신의 망나니: And unless you're special, you can't stay there long. Apparently, the Goddess's Executioner %s will be fine...
Deliver traditional Elias food to the Drifting City.
strings.아니스하고 뮐러 님이 요즘 이국적인 음식이 먹고 싶대. 그래서 %s 님께: Anise and Muller want to try some foreign cuisine. I'd like you to get it and take it to them, %s!
strings.(암브로시아가 두 눈을 반짝거리며 빤히 바라본다. 눈동자가 밤하늘의 별빛: (Ambrosia gazes at you with sparkling eyes, bright as stars in the night sky.)
strings.아, 알았어. 해줄게. 대신 사례금은 제대로 받을 거야!! 여신의 망나니: A-all right. I'll do it. But I expect proper payment! And stop calling me Goddess's Executioner!
strings.야호! 좋아. 역시! 내가 최고로 좋은 음식 보관통을 줄테니 꼭 음식 구: Yahoo! Wonderful! I'll give you the best food container, so fetch the food and deliver it. Understood, Delivery Executioner?
strings.…왜 또 다른 망나닌데…. 알았어, 알았어. 배달만 해주고 난 다시 돌아: ...Why another Executioner? Fine, fine. I'll deliver it and come straight back. I have plenty to do.
Thank you! I'll put in a good word with Narsha and the President.
strings.(일단 다녀오고 나서 생각해보자. 오랜만에 표류도시로….): (I'll think about it after the trip. Back to the Drifting City...)
Hello, %s! It's been a while! But that smell...
strings.암브로시아의 부탁을 받고 엘리아스 전통 음식을 가져왔어요!: Ambrosia asked me to bring traditional Elias food!
strings.(시야에 표류도시의 쓸쓸한 모습이 들어온다. 예전에 이곳에서 있었던 일들: (The lonely Drifting City comes into view, bringing memories of what happened here.)
strings.(이곳에서의 기억은 잃지 않았어.): (I haven't lost my memories of this place.)
Is my sister, Ambrosia, well? She must be, sending this...
strings.지붕 위에서 뭔가 하고 있긴 한데, 뭘 하는지는 모르겠어요. 이번 의뢰가: She's doing something on the roof, though I don't know what. She said she'd put in a good word with Narsha and the President when this job is done.
strings.오, 총장님하고…. 아, 나르샤…. 아하하하. 나르샤한테 미안하네. 진작: Oh, the President... Ah, Narsha... Ahahaha. I feel bad. I should have come along sooner. I hope she's not still sulking.
I'm a little frazzled. Phew... Things have been busy.
Muller looks too busy even to eat.
I'm only eating because I found a brief break...
strings.전에 도와주셔서 아시겠지만, 표류도시는 연구할 것들 투성이에요. 이곳의: You helped before, so you know this city is full of things to study. We must investigate its condition and consider what to do for the future.
strings.얼마 전부터 뭔가 이상한게 도시 이곳저곳에 나타나기 시작했어요. 뭐라고: Recently, strange things began appearing all over the city. How should I describe them? Black holes.
strings.뭐랄까 다른 세계로 향하는 문 같은 느낌이었어요. 뮐러 씨나 제가 어떻게: They felt like doors to another world. Neither Muller nor I could handle them, so we were searching for a solution.
strings.(아니스가 두 눈을 반짝거리며 빤히 바라본다. 아니스의 눈동자 또한 마치: (Anise gazes at you with sparkling eyes, radiant as a star in the dawn sky.)
strings.그래서 제가 무슨 일을 하면 되나요?: What do you need me to do?
strings.제가 아직 다른 말도 하지 않았는데, 부탁을 들어주신다니!! 그저 감사드: I haven't even asked yet, and you're helping! Thank you so much!
strings.에, 그러니까 이런 일을 잘 알고 있는 분의 소견을 듣고 싶어요. 아무래: Well, we'd like an expert opinion. I thought you might know someone familiar with such situations, %s.
strings.제국의 도움을 그냥 기다리고 있기엔 좀 불안하기도 하고…. 그리고 의회: Just waiting for the empire's help makes me uneasy... And some people in the council don't approve...
strings.그래서! %s 님께서 도와주셨으면 해요. 물론, 언니가 먼저 이야기를 꺼: So I'd like your help, %s! My sister already said it, but I'll put in a good word with Narsha and the President, too.
Someone comes to mind... I'll visit them, then we can talk.
strings.별 일 없었습니다. %s 님께서 오신걸 보니 무슨 일인지 어느 정도 짐작: Nothing unusual. Since you've come, %s, I have some idea why.
strings.(표류도시에서 이상한 현상이 나타난다고 설명한다.): (You explain the strange phenomena in the Drifting City.)
strings.모험가님이 다른 시간의 영역을 겪었던 그 장소. 그 도시의 다른 차원은: The place where you experienced another realm of time. I cannot sense that city's other dimension.
I restructured the Hyperspace Network's data to verify it, with the same result.
Strange phenomena in the Drifting City...
strings.아마도 다른 차원간의 간섭을 막는 벽, 그레이트 월이 흔들리고 있어서 그: The Great Wall, which prevents interference between dimensions, is probably shaking. As though someone is shaking it deliberately...
strings.%s 님이 찾으셨던 그분께서 신의 힘을 가진 것도 어느 정도 영향이 있지: The person you sought gaining divine power has had some influence as well, %s.
strings.이것도 이리스가 폭주하면서 벌어졌던 이상현상의 일부라는 건가요?: Is this another of the strange phenomena caused when Iris's power ran wild?
strings.데이터를 토대로 말씀드리자면 정확하지 않습니다. 영향을 받았다는 것 외에: The data does not establish that precisely. Only that it was affected...
strings.%s 님, 다른 세계의 물건을 구해 가져다 주시면 분석해 답을 드리겠습니: %s, bring me objects from another world. I'll analyze them and give you an answer. Is that acceptable?
strings.최근 모험가님께서 방문하신 곳 중에 마계의 흔적이 강하게 느껴졌던 곳이: Among places you've visited recently, have you strongly sensed traces of the Demon Realm anywhere?
The Abyss Chamber and Xerenis Magic Academy...
Outputting data. Abyssal Flame. Windy Seed Barrier Fragment...
They are objects of another dimension. Please exercise great care.
strings.다녀오셨군요. 괜찮으신지요?: You're back. Are you all right?
I'm fine. Here are the items...
strings.왜 그래요? 무슨 문제라도 있나요?: What's wrong? Is there a problem?
strings.오류가 발생했습니다. 역시 이 물건의 구성이 행성의 물건들과 다르기 때문: An error has occurred. As expected, their composition differs from this planet's objects. Another method is required.
strings.흠, 그럼 어떻게 해야 하나요? 제가 다른 물건을 가져올까요?: What should we do? Should I bring something else?
No. It's all right. You needn't worry.
strings.(사라스바티의 앞에 있던 파란 색의 홀로그램 키보드가 사라지고, 붉은 색: (The blue holographic keyboard before Sarasvati disappears, replaced by a red one.)
strings.기존 네트워크 모드에서 사용하지 않았던 새로운 프로토콜을 개방합니다. 만: Opening a new protocol not used in standard network mode. Mantra...
(Sarasvati stares at a floating screen, hands moving rapidly.)
Analysis complete. The objects you brought were consumed in the process.
strings.네. 설명해드리지요. 가져오신 물건들은 모두 마계의 기운에 영향을 받았습: Yes. Both objects were affected by Demon Realm energy.
The Abyssal Flame seems to have appeared after the Demon Realm was cut off from the Abyss Chamber. An external force also shattered the Windy Seed's barrier.
strings.시공간의 틈을 누군가 이용해 마계의 힘 일부를 사용한 것 같습니다. 혹시: Someone appears to have used a rift in spacetime to wield part of the Demon Realm's power. Does anyone come to mind?
strings.흠…. 잘 모르겠어요. 사라스바티는 초 시공 네트워크의 전부인데, 그걸: Hmm... I'm not sure. You're the whole Hyperspace Network. Can't you tell?
strings.모험가님께서는 이 별의 운명이 속한 여러 타임라인을 알고 계십니다. 시작: You know several timelines tied to this star's fate. It began in the city where you met another version of her.
strings.말씀드릴 순 없지만, 아스가르드의 과학력으로는 설명할 수 없는 시공간도: I cannot discuss it, but some times and spaces defy Asgard's science. The Demon Realm in particular...
strings.그걸 떠나 모험가님의 등장은 모두에게 변수였습니다. 초 시공 네트워크부터: Beyond that, your appearance was a variable for everyone. For the Hyperspace Network, and for others targeting this place...
strings.모험가님께서 어떤 장소에서 어떤 일을 해결할 때마다 초 시공 네트워크는: Whenever you resolved something somewhere, the network produced minor errors.
strings.그래도 새로운 프로토콜을 개방해 데이터를 갱신했고, 오류는 최소화됐습니다: But I opened a new protocol and updated the data, minimizing them. This applied only to you...
strings.확실하게 말씀드릴 수 있는 건, 모험가님께서 이 별의 미래를 더 나은 방: What I can say for certain is that you're shaping a better future for this star.
strings.유후, 사라스바티, 이 언니한테도 그런 칭찬 해줘! 칭찬받고 싶어. 사라: Yoo-hoo, Sarasvati! Praise your big sister like that, too! I want praise! Sarasvati! Sara...!
No noisy sisters, please. I dislike interruptions. Block complete...
...It's been so long since she appeared, and she gets blocked like that... I almost feel sorry for her...
strings.차단당해도 어떻게든 언니는 뚫고 들어옵니다. 어쨌든 그 도시에서 벌어지는: She always finds a way through the block. In any case, the trouble in the city is resolved.
strings.분석 과정에서 가져오신 물건의 일부를 분해해서 벌어진 시공간 틈으로 흘려: During analysis, I broke down part of the objects and sent it into the rifts. The city's phenomena should stop for a while.
strings.이건 일시적인 방법. 아무리 초 시공 네트워크라 하더라도 이 세계의 모든: This is temporary. Even the Hyperspace Network cannot intervene in every timeline of this world. You must...
I think I know what you're going to say. Thank you, Sarasvati.
strings.이제 그 도시에 있는 분에게 해결됐다고 알려주시지요. 덕분에 많은 데이터: Tell the people in that city it is resolved. Thanks to you, I collected a great deal of data.
Thank you. I'll go tell them.
We'll both be busy for a while. The adventurer and I...
strings.사라스바티, 이 언니를 칭찬해줘! 칭찬받고 싶어. 사라스바티! 사라…!!: Sarasvati, praise your big sister! I want praise! Sarasvati! Sara...!
strings.도시에 나타나던 구멍이 없어졌어요! 어떻게 하신 거에요?!: The holes in the city disappeared! How did you do it?!
Oh, good. Their science really is incredible.
strings.역시 그 사람들은 뭔가 다른 것 같아요. 안 그래도 제국 공방에도 내려와: Those people really are different. They even visited the imperial workshops to share scientific and technical knowledge.
Their way of thinking seems on another level from people in Freios.
strings.하여튼 감사드려요. 덕분에 연구에만 매진할 수 있게 됐어요. 그리고 저는: Thank you. Now we can focus on research. And I can finally take my overdue leave and visit my sister! Ta-da! ☆
strings.그리고 나르샤도 만나서 이것저것 하려구요. 모두 모험가님 덕분이랍니다~: I'll meet Narsha and do all sorts of things. All thanks to you!
strings.(역시 쌍둥이는 쌍둥인가 보네. 하는 행동까지 똑같아.): (Twins really are twins. Even their mannerisms match.)
strings.길드 연합 일이니 만큼 데이나 총장님께 제대로 보고할게요. 다음에 또 만: Since this is Guild Alliance business, I'll report properly to President Dayna. See you again.
Forgive the late greeting, %s... I thank you on behalf of the empire.
Of course. See you both again, Anise, Muller.
...Ah, already gone. I had something to say...
strings.아, 뮐러 씨. 제국 의회에선 뭐래요?: Oh, Muller. What did the imperial council say?
strings.별 말은 없었습니다. 여전히 이곳에서의 활동을 멈추게 하고 싶은 눈치였지: Nothing much. They still seem keen to halt our work here.
Hehe. Then we can just keep doing what we always do.
strings.뭐, 그렇지만…. 그건 그렇고 데이나 총장 이야기가 나온 걸 보니, 그가: Well, yes... But since President Dayna came up, does the adventurer qualify now?
To enter the Guild Alliance city...
strings.아마도 총장님께서 아시지 않을까요? 제가 할 수 있는 건 이야기를 드리는: The President probably knows, doesn't she? All I can do is report.
strings.아, 뮐러 씨! 휴가동안 뭐 하실 거에요? 레나 언니한테 가보지 않아도: Oh, Muller! What will you do on leave? Don't you need to see Lena?
strings.레나는 당분간 바쁠 것 같습니다. 여러 곳에서 필요로 하는 중요한 인재라: Lena will likely be busy for a while. She's an important talent, needed in many places.
strings.역시! 레나 언니는 대단하신 분이니까요. 그러면 저는 정리하고 언니한테: Of course! She's amazing. I'll tidy up and go see my sister. Take care of things while I'm gone, Muller!
strings.후우…. 하이렌 가의 영애께서 잘 알아서 하겠지?: Sigh... The daughter of House Highren can take care of herself, surely?
What awaits an adventurer connected to those three sisters is plain enough...
